Equivalent particle diameter with standard deviation from homogeneity study of RM BAM-P206. 10 individual bottles of BAM-P206 were randomly selected and measure 3 times each. The blue curve represents the cumulative distribution Q<sub>3</sub>(x) and shows the volume fraction of particles smaller than x in relation to the total volume. The black curve represents the distribution density q<sub>3</sub>(x) (1st derivate of Q<sub>3</sub>) and displays the probability of finding a particle with an equivalent particle diameter x in the population. For further information please see the corresponding repot for P206.
